title: Language-Guided Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
summary: A multi-agent pipeline that turns natural-language goals into multi-step robot actions on a Franka Panda arm, closing the loop between symbolic plans and what the robot actually observes.
bullets: Built a multi-agent pipeline converting natural-language goals into multi-step robot actions through LLM perception, symbolic planning, and vision-language execution on a Franka Panda arm.

Developed the vision front end with Grounding DINO and RGB-D depth back-projection to generate grounded STRIPS predicates directly from camera observations; sequenced actions with a C++ A* STRIPS planner and executed them with SmolVLA (500M) language-conditioned joint control.

Orchestrated the full observe–plan–execute–verify cycle in LangGraph with state-verification hooks that gate progression after each action, trigger replanning on failure, and close the loop between symbolic plan and observed world state.
